summary: Loading zone outside a hospital on a steep stretch of Morrow Street.

drivers.seclusion: Hospital building 3 m away; apartment blocks across the road and behind.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is a signed loading zone beside a busy through road.
drivers.traffic: Busy arterial-style street with cars parked on the opposite side.
drivers.convention: Loading zone, not a place to sleep; cars park along the north kerb instead.

sun_shade: Mostly open; shadow from the hospital block to the south in the morning.

best_section.where: Morrow Street south kerb outside Westside Private Hospital
